findings.claim_text: About 190 organisations signed the EU Code of Practice on Transparency of AI-generated Content (82 Section 1 providers / 152 Section 2 deployers), refuting a "six signatories" framing.
Anthropic's help page states no token threshold at all; the EU Code's only free-form-text number is 200 tokens; 400 tokens is a SynthID-Text benchmark generation length, not a detectability floor.
Claude Opus 5 launched 24 July 2026, before the 2 August 2026 cutoff Anthropic's marking policy keys to, so no shipping Claude model is watermarked "at launch".
